summary.description: At most two sentences: what the change does and whether it looks safe to merge.

verdict.description: request_changes only when a blocker or major finding exists.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the file the finding is about.

line.description: Line number in the new version of the file, or null when the finding is about the file as a whole.

body.description: The problem and the concrete fix, one or two sentences.
